messages:
Priya M: Starting a short thread to finalize the private-deploy upgrade modes. We need clear defaults and gates for ip-stable vs cutover vs airgap. Keep it pragmatic.

Eli V: Preference: default to ip-stable for SMBs, cutover for enterprise. Add an automated preflight that returns PASS/WARN/FAIL and a recommended mode.

Rhea P: Field ask: airgap customers need signed bundles + checksum verification and clear offline preflight docs. Also require explicit acceptance for any new inbound ports.

Sam K: Technical note: ip-stable requires a host helper daemonset that preserves host interfaces and routes. That needs NET_ADMIN and limited CAP_SYS_ADMIN; we'll document minimal RBAC.

NetOps J: For cutover, plan warm-handoffs: snapshot KV, warm caches, then switch routes. Add revert flag that can route back if smoke tests fail.

installer-bot: Canary: private-upgrade-canary-20240510 7% tests passed; CNI probe WARN for calico v3.25. Link: https://ci.internal/canary/20240510

Priya M: Proposed launch gates: 1) Preflight covers top failure modes; 2) Installer exposes --mode and --preflight; 3) Signed airgap bundle + offline verification; 4) Runbook + rollback tested in pilot. Any objections?

Eli V: No objections. I'll draft the preflight output format (table + remediation hints).

Rhea P: I'll line up two pilots (one calico, one cilium) and schedule the run.

Sam K: I'll post minimal RBAC + daemonset plan by EOD.

Priya M: Great. I'll convert this into the epic and add subtasks. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
